old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-6hr2","title":"Rust route lookup aliases any IPv6 prefix by IID and rewrites authenticated paths","description":"Security review P2. The convergence change adds RoutingTable::lookup_host_by_iid and makes Router::lookup_route fall back to it whenever exact/prefix lookup fails. rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs then accepts a route whose last hop shares only dst[8..], overwrites that authenticated final hop with the caller-supplied full destination, and forwards it. Any noncanonical 02xx alias sharing a node IID is therefore treated as the node's route even though LICHEN has one exact key-derived primary address and the upper bytes are part of identity/routing authority. Remove prefix-agnostic IID fallback from routable address lookup; explicitly translate only between validated canonical link-local control and exact ygg_addr_from_pubkey identities; add negative alias/shadow-route tests.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:21.305614Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:21.305614Z"}
